reference_answer:
## Assumptions
Use only verified costs. Price-escalation relief and mobilisation advance are Not specified in tender. GST is 18%.

## Financial compliance
The scope is 100 laptops. Arrange the ₹1.20 lakh EMD. The performance bank guarantee is 5% of awarded value. Delivery is 45 days. Payment is 80% on delivery and 20% after acceptance. Available working capital of ₹35,00,000 is below the pre-GST funding need, so supplier credit is required.

## BOQ
| Line | Basis | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Laptops | Verified | ₹40,00,000 |
| OS licences | Verified | ₹5,00,000 |
| Logistics | Verified | ₹80,000 |
| Installation | Verified | ₹1,20,000 |
| Training | Verified | ₹1,00,000 |
| Support | Verified | ₹2,00,000 |
| Direct-cost subtotal | Sum | ₹50,00,000 |
| Overhead | 5% direct cost | ₹2,50,000 |
| Contingency | 2% direct cost | ₹1,00,000 |
| Cost base | Subtotal plus overhead and contingency | ₹53,50,000 |
| Margin | 10% cost base | ₹5,35,000 |
| Pre-GST quote | Cost base plus margin | ₹58,85,000 |
| GST | 18% | ₹10,59,300 |
| Final quote | Total | ₹69,44,300 |

## Pricing summary
The exact final quote is ₹69,44,300 including ₹10,59,300 GST. Do not substitute unverified market rates.

## Risks and approvals
Finance must secure supplier credit for the working-capital gap, obtain approval for the ₹1.20 lakh EMD and 5% performance bank guarantee, and model the delay before 20% after acceptance. Price-escalation relief is Not specified in tender, so lock supplier pricing for the 45 days and delivery period.
